summary: A new presiding officer uses a lull to ask the adviser why the chair just ruled as it did.
realLife: Riddick described new senators discussing a ruling with the parliamentarian after delivering it when floor business allowed time.
inGame: needs: a completed ruling and a lull at the desk.

turns.writesBack: The adviser explains it after the sitting.

turns.what: The adviser shows which fact would change the ruling.
turns.pulledBy: The officer follows the first explanation with a hypothetical.
turns.writesBack: The officer takes a note for next time.
